Overview

Gijón is a city in Asturias with a population of 270,000. A lively Asturian coastal city with beautiful beaches, excellent cider houses, and a stunning green surroundings. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
